text:
Maya: Heads-up — Neotron wants to move forward with the upgrade: +150 seats, switch from quarterly to a 12mo term. Procurement flagged two blockers: they need a PO with vendor code and our legal needs to accept a minor SOW change. Can we coordinate signatures + enablement before their go‑live?

Jon: Great news! Do we have an amended quote with line items and net terms? I sent the pricing sheet earlier but can produce an updated PDF.

Maya: I attached the amended quote in DocSend (link below). They accepted price but asked for Net30 instead of Net45. Also asked for invoice split across two entities.

Jon: OK will re-export quote with Net30 and the split. Quick Q — do they need training included in the contract or as separate SOW?

Maya: They want two half-day cohorts for admins and end-users in the first 30 days. Prefer it included in the SOW so procurement signs off.

Sam: I can run the enablement — suggest week of 2026-05-04 for cohort 1 and 2026-05-11 for cohort 2. Need confirmation by EOD tomorrow to lock trainers.

Sara: Finance — Net30 is fine but we need a valid PO number and vendor code before invoicing. Also need the billing entity legal name + TAX ID on the contract.

Alex: Legal here — I reviewed their redlines. Two items: (1) remove unilateral auto-renew clause, (2) clarify data residency paragraph. Both are small but procurement wants a fully-signed contract before issuing PO. I can push countersigned version today if we finalize SOW language now.

Maya: Linking DocSend: https://docsend.example/Neotron-upgrade-v2 — quote v3 is there.

Jon: I updated the quote to Net30 + invoice split and uploaded as quote_v4.pdf. Sharing new link: https://docsend.example/Neotron-quote-v4.pdf

Maya: Forwarding to customer for PO issuance. @sam can you confirm training addendum text so Alex can fold into the SOW?

Sam: Draft of training addendum: 
- Two cohorts (admin / end-user) within 30 days
- Up to 10 admin seats per cohort included
- Success metrics: baseline walkthrough + adoption checklist
I can paste full text into the SOW doc now.

Alex: Paste it please. Will do a short pass and attach as Exhibit A. Also need to confirm their billing entity name + TAX ID.

Maya: Customer replied: PO will be raised but vendor code request (they asked for 'REDW-INTL-3') — finance ok with that? Their billing entity is Neotron, Inc. TAX ID: 12-3456789.

Sara: Confirmed vendor code accepted. Will allow invoice once PO + signed contract present. Please ensure TAX ID on final contract header.

Maya: Done — pasted training addendum in SOW doc and asked legal to attach.

Alex: I applied the training addendum and removed auto-renew language per customer's request. Uploaded redline + final: https://docsend.example/Neotron-signed-ready.pdf

Docusign-bot: Envelope 0x9a8 sent to customers@neotron.com for signature (2 signers). Status: sent.

Maya: Customer asked if we can split the signature flow: PO signer first, then exec sign on our side. Can we do that?

Alex: Yes — set signer routing so PO approver signs first. Docusign envelope supports sequential signing. I'll update routing.

Docusign-bot: Envelope 0x9a8 status update: signer1 (procurement@neotron.com) signed at 2026-04-14T16:22Z. Waiting for signer2.

Maya: Procurement confirmed PO number: PO-889433 — they said finance will attach once contract is signed.

Jon: All set on our side for billing changes. I'll queue the invoice after Docusign final.

Sam: Trainers blocked for both cohorts week of 05/04 and 05/11 — holding spots. Please confirm by EOD tomorrow or I have to release.

Maya: Customer asked whether onboarding will include token usage best practices and batching tips for their ML infra team. Sam, can you include a 30-min deep-dive?

Sam: Yep — adding a 30-min ML infra deep-dive to cohort 2. Noted.

Docusign-bot: Envelope 0x9a8 fully signed at 2026-04-15T09:08Z. Documents routed to all parties.

Sara: Received signed contract + PO (PO-889433). Finance will process Net30 invoice on 2026-05-01.

Maya: Awesome — I'll send confirmation to the customer and schedule kick-off. Thanks everyone. :tada: 

Jon: Can someone drop final links to archived signed contract + invoice instructions in #cs-deals? I'll post to account timeline.

Alex: Final contract link: https://docsend.example/Neotron-signed-ready.pdf

Sara: Finance note link: https://finance.example/invoice-ops/PO-889433-guidance

Maya: Closing the loop — kick-off call scheduled 2026-04-20 14:00 PT. Training cohorts reserved. Moving to closed-won pipeline. :rocket:
